terra.problem: The verse does not say nobody steps in or that running out of land stops them.
The verse does not say that running out of room is what ends their acquiring land.
The text does not say the music is loud or that it causes them to miss the LORD's work. A guessed reason is still an added reason.
The text does not say the feast keeps their eyes on the table or give that as the reason they fail to see the LORD's work.
The identification of Zion with Jerusalem is a Bible fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
The identification of Zion with Jerusalem is a Bible fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
The identification of Zion with Jerusalem is a Bible fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
The verse does not say the faithful never lower their eyes, that the arrogant had held their heads high, or that they look at their shoes.
Being silenced is not the opposite of being exalted.
The comment about how fast the scene changes adds a timeframe the verse does not give.
The comparison says the people have no plan to be in the right seat. The text does not say what they plan.
The verse does not say nobody else considers these people wise or clever.
The verse does not say nobody else judges these people wise or clever.
The verse does not say each person is the only one judging their wisdom.
“Pay up and walk free” implies the guilty person pays the bribe. The verse does not say who pays it.
Papa comments on how he tells the passage when he says he will not joke about it.
The verse says the LORD whistles, but does not say He whistles once.
The claim that a trumpet appears elsewhere in the Bible needs a reference.
A sandal strap not being broken does not establish that it is not loose. The verse does not say everything is fastened.
The verse does not say nothing is hanging off. A strap can be unbroken without being fastened.
The explanation repeats that no one can rescue the prey without adding much, making it noticeably generic.
